apihelp-bs-smw-connector-ask-store-summa: Kayd la jaanqaadaya ExtJS oo lagu fuliyo weydiimaha semantic-ka
apihelp-bs-smw-connector-ask-store-props: Sifooyinka la soo saarayo. Sifooyinkaas waxay waafaqi doonaan qaab dhismeedka iyo xogta la soo celiyey. Lammaanayaal fure-qiime ah, furuhu waa magaca dhabta ah ee sifada, qiimuhuna waa summadda la doonayo (JSON)
bs-smw-connector-async-ask-unknown-handl: Maamulaha qaabka "$1" lama diiwaangelin ama ma aha mid sax ah
apihelp-bs-smw-connector-ask-tree-store-: Qiimaha node-ka ee beddeli doona <nowiki>{{{node}}}</nowiki> boos-hayaha ku jira weydiinta

bs-smwconnector-dataquery-desc: Waxay awood u siinaysaa weydiimaha nuxurka ku jira wiki-ga
bs-smwconnector-dataquery-category-help: Ku shaandhee qaybta(qaybaha), adigoo gelitaanno badan ku kala saaraya '|'. Tusaale ahaan, 'cat1|cat2' waxay soo celinaysaa bogagga ku jira qaybaha 'cat1' AMA 'cat2'.
bs-smwconnector-dataquery-namespace-help: Ku shaandhee meel magac(yada), adigoo gelitaanno badan ku kala saaraya '|'. Tusaale ahaan, 'ns1|ns2' waxay soo celinaysaa bogagga ku jira meel magacyada 'ns1' AMA 'ns2'.
bs-smwconnector-dataquery-modified-opera: Ku shaandhee ka hor/ka dib taariikhda wax ka beddelka
bs-smwconnector-dataquery-modified-date-: Taariikhda loo isticmaalo shaandhaynta wax ka beddelka
bs-smwconnector-dataquery-printouts-help: Muuji sifo(oyinka), adigoo gelitaanno badan ku kala saaraya '|'. Tusaale ahaan, 'prop1|prop2' waxay soo celinaysaa qiimayaasha sifooyinka 'prop1' iyo 'prop2' ee bogga.
bs-smwconnector-dataquery-count-help: Xaddid tirada natiijooyinka la soo celinayo
bs-smwconnector-decision-overview-catego: Ku shaandhee hal ama dhowr qaybood, adigoo gelitaanno badan ku kala saaraya '|'.
bs-smwconnector-decision-overview-namesp: Ku shaandhee hal ama dhowr meel magac, adigoo gelitaanno badan ku kala saaraya '|'.
bs-smwconnector-decision-overview-prefix: Ku shaandhee horgalahaaga, adigoo horgalayaal badan ku kala saaraya '|'.
bs-smwconnector-decision-overview-no-res: Wax go'aanno ah lagama helin shaandheeyayaasha hadda jira
bs-smwconnector-decision-overview-drople: Waxay awood u siinaysaa weydiimaha lagu helo dulmarka go'aannada
